PIKE COUNTY RECORDER OF DEEDS
Kim S. Martin Luebrecht, Recorder of Deeds
Phone: (573) 324-5567
Email: Kiml@pikecounty-mo.gov
1st Floor of the Courthouse
Hours 8:00 a.m. - 4:30 p.m
--------------------------------------------
​The recorder of deeds issues marriage licenses and records real estate transfers, deeds of trust, power of attorney, surveys, tax liens and military discharges. Our records date back to 1825 and copies can be made for a nominal fee. For Specific questions regarding fees or recording guidelines, please call our office.
--------------------------------------------
Online Record Search
Data Availability:
Real Estate Land Records indexed in old records from March 1902 with images available (Books 123-324 Page 1857)
Deeds are indexed from January 1995 through current date with images
Tax Liens are indexed from May 1995 through current date and images are available beginning February 2008
Marriage License are indexed from 1995 through current date and images are unavailable
Printing Document Images Options:
CREDIT CARD - Fifteen (15) minute pass - $7.00 plus convenience fee of $1.95. One (1) hour pass - $25.00 plus convenience fee of $1.95.
SUBSCRIPTION - Contact the Recorder at 573-324-5567 for an application and pricing
